content.text:
To make your shadcn registry browsable at `/r/` without interfering with CLI consumers fetching `/r/*.json`, you have three main patterns.

---

### How VitePress & Static Serving Work Here

Currently, `docs/scripts/generate-registry.ts` emits JSON manifests to `docs/public/r/`:
* `https://pantoken.app/r/registry.json`
* `https://pantoken.app/r/[item].json` (e.g. `button.json`, `theme-canvas.json`, `use-instui-modal.json`)

VitePress serves `docs/public/` files at the root. Requests ending in `.json` will always serve the static file. To make human browser visits to `/r/` display a UI, you can provide an HTML route for `/r/`.

---

### Option 1: Interactive Registry Browser (Recommended)

Follow the pattern used by pantoken's other pickers ([docs/guide/cdn-picker.md](docs/guide/cdn-picker.md), [IconPicker.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/IconPicker.vue), [InteractionsPicker.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/InteractionsPicker.vue)):

1. **Create the page** at [docs/r/index.md](docs/r/index.md) (or `docs/guide/registry.md` with a redirect/alias):
   ```markdown
   ---
   title: Registry
   description: Browse pantoken themes, components, and hooks compatible with shadcn/ui.
   aside: false
   editLink: false
   ---

   <RegistryBrowser />
   ```

2. **Create the Vue component** at `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/RegistryBrowser.vue`:
   - Fetches or imports `/r/registry.json`
   - Filter tabs: **All**, **Themes** (`registry:theme`), **Hooks** (`registry:hook`), **UI Components** (`registry:ui`)
   - Search bar to filter by name/description
   - Copyable CLI install command toggle (`npx shadcn@latest add https://pantoken.app/r/<name>.json`, `pnpm dlx`, `bunx`)
   - Links to view the raw JSON manifest and corresponding docs

3. **Register the component** in [docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts):
   ```ts
   import RegistryBrowser from "./components/RegistryBrowser.vue";

   export default {
     ...Theme,
     enhanceApp({ app }) {
       app.component("RegistryBrowser", RegistryBrowser);
     }
   }
   ```

---

### Option 2: Auto-Generated Markdown Catalog

If you prefer static documentation pages generated during build time:

1. Update `docs/scripts/generate-registry.ts` to also emit [docs/r/index.md](docs/r/index.md) containing a markdown table / cards of all items, installation commands, and links to each `.json` file.
2. Add `docs/r/` to `docs/.vitepress/config.ts` nav/sidebar if desired.

---

### Option 3: Static HTML Index or Redirect in `public/r/`

If you only want a minimal directory viewer or redirect when hitting `/r/`:

* **Option 3A (Redirect to `registry.json`):**
  Add `docs/public/r/index.html` with `<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=/r/registry.json">`.
* **Option 3B (Standalone HTML catalog):**
  Emit a standalone `docs/public/r/index.html` inside `generate-registry.ts` with lightweight CSS styling listing all available endpoints.

---

### Recommendation

**Option 1** is recommended because it matches the styling of the rest of the pantoken documentation site, lets users preview component metadata, and gives them copy-paste CLI commands for adding components to their apps.

content.text:
We have implemented Option 1 to make the registry browsable at `/r/`:

1. **Created `RegistryBrowser.vue`** in [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/RegistryBrowser.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/RegistryBrowser.vue):
   - **Search & Filter:** Search by item name, title, description, or dependencies.
   - **Category Tabs:** Filter between All, Components (`registry:ui`), Themes (`registry:theme` / `registry:base`), and Hooks (`registry:hook`) with item counts.
   - **CLI Switcher:** Toggle command syntax between `npx`, `pnpm`, and `bun` (e.g. `npx shadcn@latest add https://pantoken.app/r/button.json`).
   - **One-click Copy & JSON Links:** Copy CLI installation commands with visual feedback or open the raw `/r/[name].json` manifest directly.
   - **Interactive Previews:** Expandable panels to inspect component source code or theme CSS variable mappings.

2. **Registered `RegistryBrowser`** in the VitePress theme at [docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts#L136).

3. **Created Registry Page** at [docs/r/index.md](docs/r/index.md):
   - Visiting `/r/` (or `/r`) serves the interactive browser.
   - Requesting `/r/registry.json` or `/r/[name].json` continues to serve static JSON manifests for the shadcn CLI.
